name: What has to happen before interior log home staining can even start?

mainEntity.name: What has to happen before interior log home staining can even start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior log staining is usually done after the logs are cleaned, dry, and free of dust, oils, or old finish buildup. For Colorado homes, a good stain should also account for altitude, dry air, and strong sun exposure near bright windows and open rooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: The logs need to be clean, dry, and prepped before staining. In Colorado homes, finish selection also has to account for strong sun exposure and dry indoor conditions.
